item.title: Jekyll Search Options
item.description: Introduction: Jekyll is a static HTML generation tool. Our documentation system is deployed with Jekyll, which ultimately converts Markdown into HTML files for output. The search requirement is: given a keyword, match it against a document’s title or content and list the matching documents. 1. Option One: Simple-Jekyll-Search Reference: https://github.com/christian-fei/Simple-Jekyll-Search
